units: frame pixels; interior is 480 px across like the bad floor..ceiling band

frames.name: Stepping Stones
frames.idea: Teaches the streak: three low pads, no blue. Every clean hop is +1 streak.

frames.name: Blue Toll
frames.idea: Pay or play: bounce the pad to clear the pillar, or ride through the blue and pay a heart.

frames.name: Split Lane
frames.idea: A green shelf splits the corridor: the upper lane chains two greens, the lower lane hides a blue.

frames.name: Elevator
frames.idea: Two green posts with a blue elevator between them: time the hop over or under it.

frames.name: Zig Zag
frames.idea: Floor and ceiling pads alternate; blues sit on the flat middle line, so only the zigzag is free.

frames.name: Curtain Gap
frames.idea: Staggered blue curtains: duck under the first, a floor pad throws you over the second.

frames.name: Bank Shot
frames.idea: Floor-ceiling-floor bank shots around a blue core; small floor blues punish staying low.

frames.name: Needle
frames.idea: Four tiny pads in a row with blue pistons between them: a perfect four-hop line, or a heart per miss.

frames.name: Brake Ladder
frames.idea: Alternating wall ledges: each bounce brakes the fall and adds to the streak.

frames.name: Blue Funnel
frames.idea: Blue slopes narrow the shaft; a green above the gap lines you up to drop straight through.

frames.name: Sweeper
frames.idea: A blue bar sweeps across the shaft; wall greens let you dodge to the side it just left.

frames.name: Trapdoor
frames.idea: A blue floor spans the shaft with one narrow gap; a tilted green kicks you over to it.

frames.name: Wall Steps
frames.idea: Wall ledges going up, left-right-left: a stair of bounces out of the shaft.

frames.name: Chimney
frames.idea: A broken blue column splits the shaft; climb through its gaps by bouncing between pads on alternating walls.

frames.name: Falling Rocks
frames.idea: Blue rocks drop down the shaft against you; wall greens let you side-step between drops.

frames.name: Catapult
frames.idea: A wide green at the bottom throws you high; thread the gap between the blue rocks above.

frames.name: Drop Lip
frames.idea: A green on the outer wall turns the run into the shaft; a blue on the inner side punishes cutting the corner.

frames.name: Kicker
frames.idea: A green wedge in the outer corner kicks the run upward; a blue guards the tight inside line.

frames.name: Landing Pad
frames.idea: A floor green turns the fall into forward speed; a blue sits in the exit lane if you bounce too high.

frames.name: Apex Hook
frames.idea: A ceiling green hooks the climb into the corridor; blues guard the inner corner and the low exit.

frames.name: Double Elevator
frames.idea: Three green posts, two blue elevators out of phase: hop post to post while both are low.

frames.name: Gate Crusher
frames.idea: Blue pistons close from ceiling and floor; a floor wedge launches you through the gap while it is open.

frames.name: Ramp Jump
frames.idea: A green floor ramp kicks you over a blue block: the kicker taught in one move.

frames.name: Ceiling Kicker
frames.idea: A ceiling wedge deflects a high run down and under a blue curtain.

frames.name: Shutter
frames.idea: A blue shutter slides up and down across half the corridor; pick the floor or ceiling pad to take the open half.

frames.name: Moving Gap
frames.idea: Two blues move together leaving one gap that drifts up and down between two green posts.

frames.name: Kicker Chain
frames.idea: Floor and ceiling wedges alternate; each kicks you to the next, blues fill the flat line.

frames.name: Twin Sweepers
frames.idea: Two sweepers out of phase; wall greens bounce you to whichever side is clear.

frames.name: Wall Kicker
frames.idea: Green wedges on alternating walls kick the fall side to side.

frames.name: Wait Ledge
frames.idea: Bounce on the ledge to hold your height, then drop past the sweeper once it has passed.

frames.name: Side Crusher
frames.idea: Blue pistons close from both walls; a green above lets you wait for the gap.

frames.name: Plinko
frames.idea: Staggered green pegs; ride them peg to peg into the centre exit between two blues.

frames.name: Elevator Climb
frames.idea: A blue elevator rides the centre of the shaft; climb the wall ledges while it is out of the way.

frames.name: Up Kicker
frames.idea: Wall wedges kick the climb across the shaft; a sweeper crosses between them.

frames.name: Rising Shutters
frames.idea: Three sweepers from alternating walls; weave up through each one on the side it has left.

frames.name: Half-pipe
frames.idea: Green slopes form a half-pipe at the bottom; pump across it and launch past the elevator.

frames.name: Sweep Corner
frames.idea: The outer-wall green turns you down the shaft; a sweeper below decides which side you fall.

frames.name: Double Kicker
frames.idea: Two wedges in sequence: the corner wedge kicks you up, the wall wedge sends you up the middle; an elevator guards the inside.

frames.name: Ramp Exit
frames.idea: A green slope at the bottom turns the fall into forward speed; an elevator patrols the exit.

frames.name: Corner Deflector
frames.idea: A wedge in the outer corner deflects the climb into the corridor; an elevator and an inside blue guard the exit.

frames.name: Ramp Elevator
frames.idea: A floor ramp launches you over a blue elevator; go while it is low.

frames.name: Ceiling Elevator
frames.idea: A ceiling wedge drops you under a blue elevator; go while it is high.

frames.name: Long Ramp
frames.idea: A long gentle floor slope lifts you over a tall blue block.

frames.name: Up and Under
frames.idea: The floor ramp throws you up, the ceiling wedge throws you back down under a blue curtain.

frames.name: Ramp Shutter
frames.idea: A floor ramp sends you high over a blue shutter that slides along the lower half.

frames.name: Ramp to Pad
frames.idea: Ramp onto a green pad sitting on a blue block: land it for +2 streak, miss it and pay.

frames.name: Drop Ramp
frames.idea: Fall onto a down-slope that flings you forward and low, under a blue curtain.

frames.name: Ledge Swap
frames.idea: Bounce the left ledge, let the sweeper pass, then cross to the right ledge below it.

frames.name: Shaft Slope
frames.idea: A big slope off the left wall turns the fall to the right, clear of the sweeper below.

frames.name: Wedge Gate
frames.idea: Two facing wedges make a gate; bank off one into the gap while the sweeper above is away.

frames.name: Tilt Pad
frames.idea: A tilted green pad kicks you to the right side, the side the sweeper below has just left.

frames.name: Up Deflector
frames.idea: A wedge under the left wall deflects the climb to the right, away from an elevator in the left column.

frames.name: Wait Ledge Up
frames.idea: Land on the ledge and wait for the sweeper above to pass, then climb on.

frames.name: Elevator Kick
frames.idea: Two wall wedges kick the climb across while an elevator rides the middle.

frames.name: Side Launch
frames.idea: A low slope launches you up the right side, around a blue block in the middle.

frames.name: Top Deflector
frames.idea: A wedge in the outer top corner deflects the run down the shaft, past a sweeper.

frames.name: Big Kicker
frames.idea: A big slope in the outer corner kicks the run up the shaft; an elevator patrols the inside.

frames.name: Slope Hurdle
frames.idea: The bottom slope turns the fall into a forward jump over a blue hurdle in the exit.

frames.name: Deflector Shutter
frames.idea: The outer-corner wedge sends the climb into the corridor under a blue shutter.

frames.name: Lip Kicker
frames.idea: A wedge on the corridor lip kicks you over the corner; drop down the side the sweeper is not on.

frames.name: Pad Steps
frames.idea: Two green-capped blue blocks of rising height: hop cap to cap for +2, clip a side and pay.

frames.name: Drop and Flick
frames.idea: The drop slope flings you low and up into the green face under a hanging blue, which flicks you back down.

frames.name: Ramp Block
frames.idea: A ramp built onto the front of a low blue block: hit the ramp and fly, hit the block and pay.

frames.name: Blue Table
frames.idea: A green tabletop on two blue legs: bounce the top for the streak; the tunnel under it hides a blue.

frames.name: Double Drop
frames.idea: Two drop slopes in a row, each flinging you low under a blue curtain.

frames.name: High Pad
frames.idea: A ramp to a green cap on a tall blue tower: a big jump for +2, or straight into the tower.

frames.name: Blue Sandwich
frames.idea: A floating blue slab with green on top and bottom: bounce either face, only the middle line pays.

frames.name: Ceiling Flick
frames.idea: A slope under the ceiling catches a high run and flicks it forward over a blue floor block.

frames.name: Cap Run
frames.idea: Three low green-capped blue bumps: a rhythm of three short hops.

frames.name: Capped Ledges
frames.idea: Blue wall ledges with green caps: land on the caps, catch an edge and pay.

frames.name: Moving Platform
frames.idea: The sweeper carries a green cap (it moves with the bar): time the bounce on top, or the bar takes a heart.

frames.name: Slope Sweep
frames.idea: A wall slope turns the fall to the right; the sweeper below decides when to commit.

frames.name: Blue Wait Ledge
frames.idea: M30 with a blue body under the ledge: bounce the cap, then drop off its inner edge after the sweeper passes.

frames.name: Ledge Lip
frames.idea: A green lip on a blue wall ledge kicks the fall across the shaft.

frames.name: Capped Steps Up
frames.idea: Green-capped blue ledges on alternating walls: climb cap to cap.

frames.name: Lip to Pad
frames.idea: The lip wedge kicks you over the corner onto a green-capped blue pillar in the shaft.

frames.name: Kicker Tower
frames.idea: A green kicker on top of a blue tower in the outer corner: hit the kicker high, not the tower.

frames.name: Drop Exit
frames.idea: A drop slope at the shaft bottom flings you low along the exit, under a blue curtain.

frames.name: Deflect to Cap
frames.idea: The outer-corner wedge sends the climb onto a green-capped blue block in the corridor.

frames.name: Landing Block
frames.idea: Land the fall on a green-capped blue block and bounce out along the exit; miss it and the low exit pays.

frames.name: Ramp Window
frames.idea: A blue wall fills the corridor except a 100 px slot at the top; only the ramp gets you there.

frames.name: Tower Pair
frames.idea: Ramp to two green-capped towers under a blue ceiling slab: the arc between caps must stay low.

frames.name: Big Elevator
frames.idea: A tall blue elevator covers most of the height between two green posts; only timing gets you past.

frames.name: Deflect Under
frames.idea: The ceiling wedge drops you into a 100 px gap under a blue curtain that hangs almost to the floor.

frames.name: Low Tunnel
frames.idea: The drop slope flings you under a long blue ceiling; a green pad mid-tunnel keeps you low and fast.

frames.name: Cap Staircase
frames.idea: Three capped towers rising across the floor under a blue ceiling strip: three hops, no low route.

frames.name: Bounce Window
frames.idea: A full blue wall with one window at mid height; the floor pad must bounce you right into it.

frames.name: Blue Band
frames.idea: Blue strips line the whole floor and ceiling; zigzag between green caps on them, touching nothing else.

frames.name: Wall Cap
frames.idea: A blue wall almost to the ceiling with a green cap: ramp onto the cap and bounce through the 78 px slot.

frames.name: Wide Sweeper
frames.idea: A sweeper 300 px wide leaves only a 180 px gap; wait on the ledge, then drop as the gap reaches you.

frames.name: Trapdoor Kick
frames.idea: A blue floor spans the shaft with one 140 px gap; the wall wedge kicks you across to it.

frames.name: Ledge Relay
frames.idea: Right ledge, left ledge, then drop past a wide sweeper on the side it has left.

frames.name: Cap Ladder Down
frames.idea: Capped blue ledges reach 300 px across from alternating walls; bounce the caps, the gaps are narrow.

frames.name: Needle Drop
frames.idea: A capped blue slab fills the shaft but 60 px at each side: bounce the cap, then thread a side slot.

frames.name: Lip Over Sweeper
frames.idea: The lip wedge kicks you over the corner; a 300 px sweeper in the shaft leaves one side to fall down.

frames.name: Kicker Column
frames.idea: A blue column fills the inner half of the shaft; the corner kicker must send you straight up the outer side.

frames.name: Slope Tunnel
frames.idea: The bottom slope must fling you into a 140 px tunnel under a blue slab that fills the exit.

frames.name: Deflect Window
frames.idea: The outer-corner wedge must send the climb through a 180 px window in a blue wall across the exit.

frames.name: Capped Lip
frames.idea: A capped blue block on the corridor lip throws you over the corner; a wide sweeper guards the shaft.

frames.name: Elevator Exit
frames.idea: The slope flings you along the exit past a blue elevator covering more than half its height.

frames.name: Ramp Slot
frames.idea: A blue wall fills the corridor below a 180 px slot at the top; the ramp throws you into it.

frames.name: Ceiling Slot
frames.idea: The ceiling wedge drops you into the 180 px slot under a blue curtain.

frames.name: Tower Under Roof
frames.idea: Ramp onto a capped blue tower under a blue roof block: 170 px between cap and roof.

frames.name: Cap Ladder Run
frames.idea: The corridor version of M93: capped towers from the floor, a hanging block with a green face, 180 px gaps.

frames.name: Wide Tunnel
frames.idea: The drop slope flings you low into a 250 px tunnel under a long blue roof.

frames.name: Elevator Gate
frames.idea: M04 with a 220 px elevator: it always leaves 260 px free, but never the same half.

frames.name: Wide Window
frames.idea: A full blue wall with a 180 px window; the floor pad bounces you into it.

frames.name: Over and Under
frames.idea: The ramp sends you over a wall through the top slot, then a ceiling wedge drops you under a curtain.

frames.name: Cap Ladder Wide
frames.idea: M93 with 260 px capped ledges and 220 px gaps.

frames.name: Cap Ladder Three
frames.idea: Three capped ledges from alternating walls: three bounces down a zigzag, 220 px gaps.

frames.name: Capped Wait Ledge
frames.idea: M30 on a capped blue ledge with a 260 px sweeper below: wait, then drop through the 220 px gap.

frames.name: Wedge Trapdoor
frames.idea: A blue floor with a 200 px gap; the wall wedge kicks you across to it.

frames.name: Slope to Cap
frames.idea: A wall slope kicks you onto a capped ledge on the far wall; drop past its end.

frames.name: Cap and Sweep
frames.idea: Bounce a capped ledge, then drop past a 240 px sweeper on the side it has left.

frames.name: Kicker Window
frames.idea: The corner kicker sends you up through a 180 px window in a blue bar across the shaft.

frames.name: Lip to Ledge
frames.idea: The lip wedge kicks you over the corner onto a capped ledge; drop through the 220 px gap beside it.

frames.name: Slope Window
frames.idea: The bottom slope flings you through a 180 px window in a blue wall across the exit.

frames.name: Deflect Over
frames.idea: The corner wedge must send the climb over a blue wall, through the 180 px slot under the ceiling.

frames.name: Cap Under Curtain
frames.idea: Land on a capped block at the bottom and bounce out low, under a curtain leaving a 180 px slot.

frames.name: Lip Ladder
frames.idea: The lip wedge, then two capped ledges from alternating sides down the shaft.

frames.name: Ramp Window Tower
frames.idea: Ramp through a 180 px window, then land on a capped tower: three moves, one rhythm.

frames.name: Drop Window
frames.idea: The drop slope flings you low through a 180 px window near the floor.

frames.name: Double Ramp
frames.idea: Two ramps, two tall blue blocks: M23 twice in a row.

frames.name: Wedge Pair
frames.idea: M24 twice: ceiling wedge, under a curtain, floor pad back up, ceiling wedge, under the next.

frames.name: Tower Window
frames.idea: Ramp onto a capped tower, which throws you through a 180 px window in the next wall.

frames.name: Elevator Window
frames.idea: Time the M04 elevator, then hit the 180 px window in the wall behind it.

frames.name: Drop Under Roof
frames.idea: The drop slope flings you under a low blue roof onto a capped block: stay low the whole way.

frames.name: Cap Ladder Four
frames.idea: M110 with a fourth ledge: four capped bounces down the zigzag, 220 px gaps.

frames.name: Cap Ladder Sweep
frames.idea: Two capped ledges, then a 240 px sweeper at the bottom: drop on the side it has left.

frames.name: Slope Trapdoor
frames.idea: M117 in a shaft: a wall slope sends you across into the 180 px gap of a blue floor.

frames.name: Capped Funnel
frames.idea: Two capped ledges leave a 180 px gap in the middle; a sweeper above crosses it.

frames.name: Wait Ladder
frames.idea: Capped wait ledge, sweeper, capped ledge: M30 into M110.

frames.name: Trapdoor Ladder
frames.idea: Two capped ledges, then a blue floor with a 200 px gap on the far side.

frames.name: Double Window
frames.idea: The bottom slope flings you through two offset 180 px windows in a row.

frames.name: Cap Window
frames.idea: Land on a capped block at the bottom; it bounces you through a 180 px window in the exit.

frames.name: Deflect Two Windows
frames.idea: M98 with two walls: the deflected line must pass both 180 px windows.

frames.name: Kicker Past Ledge
frames.idea: The M18 kicker must send you up the outer side, past a capped ledge reaching from the inner wall.

frames.name: Lip Trapdoor
frames.idea: The M60 lip kicks you over the corner toward a 200 px gap in a blue floor across the shaft.

frames.name: Ladder to Slope
frames.idea: M110 into M117: a capped ledge, the bottom slope, then a 180 px window in the exit.

frames.name: Slope Slot High
frames.idea: The bottom slope must fling you high, through the 190 px slot above a blue wall in the exit.
